excluded_or_invalid_early_stops.note: Early stops on invalid or hacked runs are a DIFFERENT mechanism from exact curtailment. They save nothing: the trial was paid for and its result cannot be used, so the run must be repeated. Reported separately so curtailment savings are not overstated.

method: naive cost = 5 x (measured trials) x (mean realised cost per calibration trial). Per-trial cost varies with trace length, so this is an estimate at constant per-trial cost, not a billing fact.
